# 上方鈞天演範真經

**ID:** KR5e0036
**Custom ID:** ZB5e0036

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Perfect Scripture of the Higher-Realm Jūntiān Expanding-Norms*

Anonymous; Táng-Sòng

A Daoist scripture on the "Jūntiān" (one of the nine heavens) expounding cosmic norms. Preserved as **DZ 1134** / CT 1134 (Tài píng bù 太平部).

**Dating.** Táng-Sòng. Dynasty: 唐-宋.
